_comment: Real programs from the Sept 2026 research. Re-verify every figure on the platform before acting; scopes and pools change weekly. max_payout_usd is the program/pool maximum, not the expected payout. days_since_scope_change and competition are estimates the operator updates from the live scope page. Feed this file to rank.py.

_schema.name: program or contest name
_schema.days_since_scope_change: days since the in-scope code last changed (lower = fresher = fewer eyes)
_schema.competition: low | medium | high — how picked-over the surface is
_schema.deadline: ISO date if time-boxed, else null

targets.name: Immunefi standing bounties (mid-cap programs)
targets.kyc: at payout only; 70% paid if declined
targets.notes: Target $50k-$500k-cap programs with code changed in the last 60 days, not the $5M+ tier where everyone looks. New accounts capped at 1 submission per 24h until first paid report.

targets.name: Cantina standing bounties
targets.notes: Largest live pool found ($34M+ aggregate). USDC via multisig payout.

targets.name: Immunefi audit competitions
targets.notes: The product absorbing Code4rena's business. Enter in the first hours — duplicates split the pool. ENS pool $70k was live at research time; refresh the live list.

targets.name: Sherlock contests
targets.notes: No published AI ban. Standing bounty product needs a $250 USDC stake per report, refunded if valid.

targets.name: CodeHawks First Flights
targets.notes: Lowest-stakes calibration run. Use First Flights to prove the pipeline before risking reputation on a big contest.

targets.name: HackenProof contests
targets.notes: Several contests a month, $85k-$300k pools. AI policy not published — assume industry norm (verified OK, slop banned).

targets.name: Anthropic bug bounty (general track)
targets.notes: General track public only since May 2026, still under-hunted. Classic web bugs in the product are paid; jailbreaks/prompt injection are NOT. Safety track needs an NDA and is separate.

targets.name: Google VRP / AI VRP
targets.notes: AI VRP track launched Oct 2025, comparatively fresh. Jailbreaks/prompt injection/system-prompt extraction explicitly unpaid; classic bugs in AI products are paid.
